svg.aria-label: DementiaBot on a bench: a white board on four yellow gear motors with rubber wheels, carrying a power bank with a round speaker on it, a white medicine box whose lid an SG90 servo lifts, a Raspberry Pi in a black case with a USB webcam on top, and a battery box. In front of it a peg figure standing in for the patient rides a carriage along a rail; the robot follows it at a steady distance, and at reminder time the speaker sounds and the medicine box opens.
